This '''mission''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and a Rebel agent were sent to the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Skip 52]], located in the [[Smuggler's Run/Legends|Smuggler's Run]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]], to recover a lost shipment of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. After a fight to the death with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] operatives, the two Rebels succeeded in recovering the shipment.
